purpose: Enterprise rollout scoring for newly introduced AI and emerging technologies, emphasizing staged adoption, policy adaptation, and regulatory readiness.

metric_mapping.extraction_hint: Measure whether rollout guardrails are consistently enforced during staged introduction.
Track how quickly critical rollout issues can be corrected after discovery.
Measure how quickly policy or control changes propagate into governed rollout artifacts.
Use review, promotion, and freeze lineage to quantify change approval traceability.
Keep high-impact rollout decisions under explicit human review and measure that coverage.
Track whether each experimental capability version has a governed approval chain.
Measure whether new-technology limits and operating bounds are disclosed to reviewers.
Use exportability and audit-readiness of rollout artifacts as a regulatory interoperability proxy.
